title: niphobolus obovatus
intro: Niphobolus obovatus, commonly known as Maidenhair Fern, is a type of plant that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing several health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving respiratory issues, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Niphobolus obovatus include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral activities, which can help in treating various conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
